chapter_seo_title: Deceived: Li Huowang Discovers the White Wuchang Is a Government Agent
chapter_meta_description: The White Wuchang isn't a ghost—it's a bureaucrat. Li Huowang learns he's been protecting a family of heretical cultivators from the Supervisory Heavenly Office.
og_description: The terrifying White Wuchang is unmasked as an Office agent. Bai Sai's family are wanted heretics. Li Huowang's trust has been a weapon against him.
twitter_title: The White Wuchang was a *cop* all along.
twitter_description: Li Huowang just learned the supernatural nightmare he's been fighting is actually a government agent. And Bai Sai? Yeah, he's been playing him.

lore_anchors.definition: A folk deity in Chinese mythology, one of the two underworld messengers who escort souls. In this novel, the horror is subverted when the "entity" is revealed to be a human operative wearing a mask.
A government-sponsored supernatural law enforcement body in the Dao-Twisted World; they operate with near-total autonomy and prioritize "stabilizing" threats over saving lives.
The clan head of the Bai family; presents himself as a grateful patriarch but is secretly a member of the White Lotus Society, a heretical cult hunted by the Office.

A secret religious network in Chinese history, often associated with millenarian rebellions and worship of the Eternal Mother. In the Dao-Twisted World, they are framed as heretical cultivators colluding with evil spirits.
An official credential carried by agents of the Supervisory Heavenly Office; it serves as both proof of authority and a warning to supernatural entities.
